fieldData.acrm---key-feature-3-content:
The supervisor hears about a fail

When a worker scores under the pass mark, the app emails their supervisor the name, the score, and each missed question. Send the same alert to a Slack channel if you prefer.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: Halloran Sands Builders' Monday toolbox talk quiz: 22 workers answered 5 questions, 9 missed the question on when fall protection starts, and foreman Matthias Groult gets the count in a Slack message.
